title: 03 Sales Enquiry And Qualification
description: Car questions, qualifying the customer, test drives and the hand-off to the showroom. Q1 to Q13 are the questions for the Sales workshop on 7 October. 47 cases: 19 agreed, 14 our design, 14 open.

nodes.title: Sales Enquiry And Qualification
nodes.detail: Car questions, qualifying the customer, test drives and the hand-off to the showroom. Q1 to Q13 are the questions for the Sales workshop on 7 October. 47 cases: 19 agreed, 14 our design, 14 open.

nodes.title: Qualify
nodes.detail: 9 cases

nodes.title: Buying for a company, or a van, bus or pickup
nodes.detail: On the corporate list: fleet sales. Otherwise: a business lead to the showroom.

cases.when: Buying for a company, or a van, bus or pickup
cases.agent_does: On the corporate list: fleet sales. Otherwise: a business lead to the showroom.

nodes.title: Doesn’t want the showroom to call
nodes.detail: No lead. Gives the showroom number.

cases.when: Doesn’t want the showroom to call
cases.agent_does: No lead. Gives the showroom number.

nodes.title: Wants a test drive or to buy
nodes.detail: Name, mobile, model, when they plan to buy, cash or finance, any trade-in, preferred showroom.
nodes.notes: Open (Sales workshop Q4): What must the AI agent ask before passing the customer to the showroom?

cases.when: Wants a test drive or to buy
cases.agent_does: Name, mobile, model, when they plan to buy, cash or finance, any trade-in, preferred showroom.
cases.open_question: What must the AI agent ask before passing the customer to the showroom?

nodes.title: Already has an open lead
nodes.detail: Add it to the existing lead if it’s less than 30 days old, so the same sales executive keeps the customer.
nodes.notes: Open (Sales workshop Q5): Should the AI agent add this to the lead from two weeks ago, or create a new lead?

cases.when: Already has an open lead
cases.agent_does: Add it to the existing lead if it’s less than 30 days old, so the same sales executive keeps the customer.
cases.open_question: Should the AI agent add this to the lead from two weeks ago, or create a new lead?

nodes.title: Shows interest in buying
nodes.detail: Yes. Today every enquiry is marked Hot, so we keep that. When they plan to buy is noted on the lead.
nodes.notes: Open (Sales workshop Q6): Should this be marked as a Hot lead?

cases.when: Shows interest in buying
cases.agent_does: Yes. Today every enquiry is marked Hot, so we keep that. When they plan to buy is noted on the lead.
cases.open_question: Should this be marked as a Hot lead?

nodes.title: Plans to buy later

cases.when: Plans to buy later
cases.agent_does: Notes when to call back, with their OK.

cases.when: Wants to buy now
cases.agent_does: A callback. The AI agent tells the caller when to expect the call.
cases.open_question: Should the AI agent put the call straight through to the showroom, or arrange a callback?

nodes.title: Showroom And Time
nodes.detail: 7 cases

nodes.title: Wants a visit only, two models, or a test drive at home
nodes.detail: Only at the showroom. If they ask for one at home, the AI agent notes it and the showroom calls them to arrange it.

cases.agent_does: Only at the showroom. If they ask for one at home, the AI agent notes it and the showroom calls them to arrange it.

cases.agent_does: The showroom confirms it first, so the customer is never promised a car that isn’t free.
cases.open_question: Is the booking confirmed on the call, or does the showroom confirm it first?

nodes.title: After The Call
nodes.detail: 4 cases

nodes.title: Has been passed to the showroom
nodes.detail: The lead carries the call summary, so the customer never repeats themselves.

cases.when: Has been passed to the showroom
cases.agent_does: The lead carries the call summary, so the customer never repeats themselves.

nodes.title: Waits for the showroom’s call
nodes.detail: Within 60 minutes if the showroom is open. If it’s closed, first thing the next morning. If the customer asked for a time, at that time.
nodes.notes: Open (Sales workshop Q12): How soon should the sales executive call the customer?

cases.when: Waits for the showroom’s call
cases.agent_does: Within 60 minutes if the showroom is open. If it’s closed, first thing the next morning. If the customer asked for a time, at that time.
cases.open_question: How soon should the sales executive call the customer?

nodes.title: Isn’t reached by the showroom
nodes.detail: The sales manager checks it before it’s closed and notes the reason. If a test drive is booked, the lead stays open.
nodes.notes: Open (Sales workshop Q13): What should happen to the lead?

cases.when: Isn’t reached by the showroom
cases.agent_does: The sales manager checks it before it’s closed and notes the reason. If a test drive is booked, the lead stays open.
cases.open_question: What should happen to the lead?

nodes.title: Has had the test drive
nodes.detail: The showroom records the outcome on the lead.

cases.when: Has had the test drive
cases.agent_does: The showroom records the outcome on the lead.
